Storing hydrogen in the hydrogen car: keep it in the storage, to prevent the tank from being tipped over.

Avoid carrying a hydrogen cylinder by the knob.

Make sure both hydrogen regulator (loosen screw valve is closed) and hydrogen tank (tighten knob) valves are closed before opening hydrogen valve

-Hydrogen is extremely flammable, if there is a leak, immediately close hydrogen valve, cause could be the nipple for the regulator-tank connector is not oriented properly

**safety using a power supply that plugs into the wall,**

-Make sure no metal clamp is touching other metal,

-connect power supply to wall

-make sure it is on and voltage is correct (12v).

-Then press out-on button so no voltage is flowing from power supply and then connect clamps to leads

-make sure no metal in connection is touching other metal

-safety switches, emergency shut off will cut all power, need to unlock the emergency and hit reset button to return power

-emergency button can be hit to cut all hydrogen flow and power, located on the back right (same side as hydrogen tank)
